messages.author: ieb
messages.text:
The last update has done a major overhaul on how pop grows. Where before every city had it's own growth & limits. The new system groups all cities and land togheter, and bases pop growth off of current pop. I feel like it would be fair to add a vote for this new system too.

I do have to say I am not exactly happy with either of the systems, as the old one left the ability for very rapid growth and the new one has more or less put a hard cap in place on how much you can practically grow.
